blurb: 65+ years of family experience fishing for walleye, perch and smallmouth bass in the western basin of Lake Erie. Captain Mike Sawyer offers an 8 hour fishing charter for up to six people. The fishing charter departs from Catawba Landing Marina in Port Clinton, Ohio. 5-hour day & evening charters can also be arranged. Call or text Captain Mike today to arrange your charter,
